sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Augmented Counter III is a Pictos in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33. Effect: Increased Counterattack damage.

sections.title: How to Get Augmented Counter III
sections.content: Location: Lumiere Act III - defeat the Chromatic Echassier (missable).

sections.title: Is It Worth Equipping?
sections.content: Pictos unlock a Lumina after four battles, so equipping it once is enough to keep the effect permanently available for the Lumina cost.
